# Blurfer 1.1

Blurfer 1.1 improves payload library management and makes folder refreshes more reliable across desktop and Android.

## Highlights

- Desktop now includes payload deletion and a folder browser with payload previews.
- Android now handles deleted, hidden, trashed, and stale folder entries more reliably.
- Folder handling, queue refreshes, and release builds have been cleaned up across platforms.

## Downloads

- `Blurfer.exe` for Windows
- `Blurfer-x86_64.AppImage` or `Blurfer-linux-x86_64.bin` for Linux
- `Blurfer.apk` for Android
